title: Reliable saved AI recommendations
description: Completed recommendations remain readable for the same finding and assessed commit when model routes change or source/model services are unavailable. Health guidance resolves the exact saved finding rather than a summary-only report. Structured response schemas and clearer failure explanations distinguish unavailable code, invalid responses and truncated recommendations while retaining saved rule guidance.
upgrade: Recreate matching API, worker and web services. Existing successful recommendations are reused when their finding and assessed-commit identity matches.
